nativeWindows.environment: Parallels Windows 11 ARM64; x64 binary under emulation in interactive desktop session

visualInspection.3DPreview: box, grid and axes rendered; tier 2

dependencyAudit: NuGet known-vulnerability query returned no vulnerable project dependencies in this build; no complete security guarantee.

privacy.apiKey: Windows current-user DPAPI; kept outside drawing files
privacy.chatPersistence: No automatic transcript storage; explicit insertion places answer on canvas
privacy.drawingsSent: Only an explicit attachment option sends a PNG with the typed prompt
privacy.localRecognition: Tesseract English text OCR and ONNX single-symbol model run locally
privacy.telemetry: No telemetry collector or analytics SDK in this source

knownLimitations: Unsigned Test release; Windows may show an unknown publisher or SmartScreen warning.
Not yet tested on a physical Intel/AMD Windows 11 PC or a physical drawing tablet.
No sustained 120 FPS, CPU/RAM benchmark, or zero-latency claim.
Text OCR is reviewed before replacement; synthetic HELLO GLIDE fixture returned ELLO GLIDE. Accuracy is not guaranteed.
Single-symbol recognition does not parse full handwritten equations.
Live OpenAI, Ollama and Craft service accounts were not used in these checks; service transport logic was exercised with mocks.
Windows PDF export embeds a raster drawing.
Tablet support depends on manufacturer drivers; proprietary OLED remote integrations are not guaranteed.
